speaker: Doctor
text: The positive Nikolsky sign and flaccid blisters strongly suggest Pemphigus Vulgaris, but I need to rule out other conditions. Do you have a history of taking any new medications recently, such as penicillins, cephalosporins, or NSAIDs?

text: I recently started taking captopril for my high blood pressure, but I stopped taking meloxicam two weeks ago. I haven't taken any penicillins or cephalosporins recently.
